preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Loan Payment Details Report'

update.column: SELECT ml.account_no AS 'Account Number/Loan ID', mc.display_name AS 'Client Name', mc.id AS 'Client ID', mo.name AS 'Office', lp.name AS 'Loan Product', pt.value AS 'Payment Type', ml.currency_code AS 'Currency', mlt.id AS 'Transaction ID', mlt.transaction_date AS 'Transaction Date', mlt.amount AS 'Total Amount Paid', COALESCE(mlt.principal_portion_derived,0) AS 'Principal Paid', COALESCE(mlt.interest_portion_derived,0) AS 'Interest Paid', ( COALESCE(mlt.fee_charges_portion_derived,0) + COALESCE(mlt.penalty_charges_portion_derived,0) + COALESCE(mlt.overpayment_portion_derived,0) + COALESCE(mlt.unrecognized_income_portion,0) ) AS 'Charges & Others Paid', cvp.code_value AS 'Province', adr.physical_address_sector AS 'Sector', adr.physical_address_cell AS 'Cell', adr.physical_address_district AS 'District', mpd.receipt_number AS 'Reference Number', mpd.routing_code AS 'Payment Hub Transaction ID', mpd.mfi_code AS 'MFI Code', MIN(creator.username) AS 'Created By', MIN(gl.created_date) AS 'Created On', CASE WHEN mlt.is_reversed = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS 'Is Reversed', CASE WHEN mlt.is_reversed = 1 THEN MAX(rev_by.username) ELSE NULL END AS 'Reversed By', CASE WHEN mlt.is_reversed = 1 THEN MAX(gl.created_date) ELSE NULL END AS 'Reversed On' FROM m_loan ml JOIN m_client mc ON ml.client_id = mc.id JOIN m_product_loan lp ON ml.product_id = lp.id JOIN m_loan_transaction mlt ON ml.id = mlt.loan_id JOIN m_office mo ON mo.id = ( SELECT eo.office_id FROM v_loan_entity_office eo WHERE eo.loan_id = ml.id AND mlt.transaction_date >= eo.valid_from AND mlt.transaction_date < eo.valid_to) JOIN m_payment_detail mpd ON mlt.payment_detail_id = mpd.id LEFT JOIN m_payment_type pt ON mpd.payment_type_id = pt.id LEFT JOIN acc_gl_journal_entry gl ON gl.loan_transaction_id = mlt.id LEFT JOIN m_appuser creator ON gl.created_date = ( SELECT MIN(gl2.created_date) FROM acc_gl_journal_entry gl2 WHERE gl2.loan_transaction_id = mlt.id ) AND gl.createdby_id = creator.id LEFT JOIN m_appuser rev_by ON gl.created_date = ( SELECT MAX(gl3.created_date) FROM acc_gl_journal_entry gl3 WHERE gl3.loan_transaction_id = mlt.id ) AND gl.createdby_id = rev_by.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cdr.client_id, MIN(addr.physical_address_sector) AS physical_address_sector, MIN(addr.physical_address_district) AS physical_address_district, MIN(addr.physical_address_cell) AS physical_address_cell, MIN(addr.state_province_id) AS state_province_id FROM m_client_address cdr JOIN m_address addr ON addr.id = cdr.address_id GROUP BY cdr.client_id ) adr ON mc.id = adr.client_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value cvp ON cvp.id = adr.state_province_id WHERE (mlt.transaction_type_enum = 2 OR mlt.transaction_type_enum = 8) AND ('${startDate}' IS NULL OR mlt.transaction_date >= '${startDate}') AND ('${endDate}' IS NULL OR mlt.transaction_date <= '${endDate}') AND ( ${officeId} = -1 OR mo.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT( IFNULL((SELECT hierarchy FROM m_office WHERE id = ${officeId}), ''), '%' ) ) AND (${paymentTypeId} = -1 OR pt.id = ${paymentTypeId}) AND ('${currencyId}' IN ('-1', '0') OR ml.currency_code = '${currencyId}') GROUP BY ml.account_no, mc.id, mo.id, mo.name, lp.name, pt.value, ml.currency_code, mlt.id, mlt.transaction_date, mlt.amount, mpd.receipt_number, mpd.routing_code, mpd.mfi_code, mlt.is_reversed ORDER BY mlt.transaction_date DESC
